new_statements.rule_in_words: Word stress is non-contrastive and falls on the penultimate syllable; it is not marked in the orthography. The later OPD hedges slightly ('tends to occur on the penultimate syllable') without naming exceptions.
new_statements.secondary_stress: Nothing said about secondary stress in either source.
new_statements.exceptions: None named. The OPD's 'tends to' implies possible exceptions but gives no examples; OPD example words carry no stress marks.
new_statements.domain_note: Stated for the word (orthography note in a grammar sketch; OPD suprasegmentals line). No discussion of phrase-level prominence or of monosyllables/clitics.
new_statements.identity_note: Both first-hand sources describe the Umua (major) dialect of Mangseng (Glottolog umua1241): the thesis states 'This paper will only deal with the Umua dialect' (printed p.3) and the OPD header reads 'Mangseng [Umua dialect] (Mangsing) Language [MBH]'. The Marapu dialect (mara1401, four NE villages) is not covered. Author lived among the Mangseng from 1982 (SIL).
